```{r}
rp <- rpart(INTRDVX ~ . - INTRDVX_ - FINLWT21, data=z, weights=FINLWT21,method="anova"). # uses weights to minimize E w(y_i - y_hat_i) ^ 2 instead of just E (y_i - y_hat_i) ^ 2 and method = anova signigies to use regression tree please. 
rpart.plot(rp)
pred <- predict(rp,newdata=z)
w.mean <- weighted.mean(pred,z$FINLWT21)
w.mean
```
